english.note: Use this when the intensity is a clearly strong sensation, reaction, feeling, or thought rather than just something being generally powerful.
Use this for pain, pleasure, or another feeling that is exceptionally intense.
Use this specifically for overwhelming intensity in sensations, emotions, reactions, or effects rather than sheer power.
Use this as the all-purpose adjective when acute means intense or powerful.
Use this for intensely vivid colours or other strongly expressed impressions.
